_about: Every phrasing must ask the same question as the template, with the same yes/no polarity (2026-10-09: 'is the graph acyclic?' was the opposite of 'is there a cycle?' and was graded wrong when answered right). Hand-written phrasings of each task's question, for the routing eval (eval/routing.py). Placeholders are the task's parameters, filled with real parameters from the dataset. dev: for building and tuning routers. test: held out, like graphs 50-99: never look at routing errors on these while tuning. 'unknown': questions no task answers; the router must say unknown.
